Hi Laila — thanks for the clear note and the context. Happy to help.

Quick answers:
- We do have a nonprofit/academic credits workflow for small pilots. For PLG signups we typically issue a one-off credit that attaches to the account email you used when signing up (looks like hello@communitylab.org).
- We can accommodate the ~120k-token ask; we usually express credits in USD — can either issue a $500 credit or a token-based allocation.

Before I issue this I need sign-off from our credits approvals team for pro bono grants > $250. I'm looping in Rishi (finance approvals) and Marissa (programs) to confirm.

If you can send a very short use case note (2–3 bullets) and a preferred expiration window (8 weeks is fine), I will push this through and share issuance details.

Onboarding helper: Dev from our SDK team is cc'd — he can help with any quick integration questions.

Best,
